name: GanttTableTbody
description: a Gantt chart table interactive grid tbody for planning schedule visualization <tbody>
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: Implicit `rowgroup` role from the `<tbody>` element -- groups the body rows of the grid
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `children`: slot (required) -- task rows representing items and their timeline data
`...restProps`: Any additional HTML attributes passed to the `<tbody>` element
